summary: `implicit` lets OpenAI add one automatic cache breakpoint plus up to three of your explicit ones; `explicit` disables the automatic breakpoint and writes up to four of yours.
combines: Explicit breakpoints are placed with `prompt_cache_breakpoint` on content blocks; up to four writes per request, and matching considers the latest 80 breakpoints in the conversation.
With `explicit` mode and no explicit breakpoints, the request uses no prompt caching at all.
